root_motivation: - **Who:** any MCP client or agent that builds arguments from `tools/list` `inputSchema`, including the synthorg conformance link, the only caller exercising this today. - **What:** a call the schema permits is refused for its shape. The rule is in handler code and sometimes in description prose, which a schema-driven client does not parse. - **Evidence (conformance-20261023T132001Z, re-read by a sonnet verifier at mcphost@83540f8, refusal sites from the same tree):** - Pattern, 6: `host.claim.dns.check` and `.start` `domain` (refused by `normalize_domain`, `src/verify.rs:355-367`; descriptors `src/verify.rs:237-262`); `host.secret.leak_test` `name` (inline `chars().all`, `src/handler.rs:10818`; descriptor `:2400`); `host.sync.create` `table` (`tables::is_valid_ident`, `src/sync/mod.rs:323-325`, although `tables::IDENT_PATTERN` exists at `src/tables.rs:263` and `host.table.create` uses it at `src/handler.rs:2660`; descriptor `:5144`); `host.tool.spec_shared` `tool` (`split_once('.')...
user_persona: An agent that calls host.sync.create with a source ref and gets a scheduled mirror in one call; Operator Joe who reads docs/tools.md and llms.txt and knows both were rendered from the SourceKind enum.

acceptance_criteria.description: Given every validated descriptor, When the generated test sets one string leaf lacking `pattern`/`enum` to each `SHAPE_PROBE_STRINGS` value, or one array lacking `uniqueItems` whose `maxItems` allows two to two equal items, via `build_router`, Then every `args`/`spec` reply has a validator refusal or a `SCHEMA_VALID_REFUSALS` entry with reason `referential` or `normalised`, else it fails naming tool and pointer.

Given every descriptor's input schema, When the generated scan walks every property (through `properties`, `items`, `anyOf`, `oneOf`), Then each property or each `anyOf`/`oneOf` branch carries `type`, `enum`, `const` or `$ref`, else it fails naming tool and JSON pointer.

Given a `TestServer` over `build_router`, When `host.policy.set` gets `rule: "toolconf-probe"` and then a one-element list whose item is valid under the new item schema (an `op` from `RuleOp`), Then the first is refused by the validator at `/rule` with constraint `type` and `handler_runs` stays 0, and the second reaches the handler.

Given every `SHAPE_CHECKS` row (pattern const, handler check fn or `None`, `accepts: &[&str]`), When each `SHAPE_PROBE_STRINGS` value and each row's `accepts` string runs through the pattern and the check fn, Then accept/reject is identical per value, every `accepts` string is accepted, and every descriptor `pattern` value equals some row's const.

Given `host.lineage.blast_radius`, When its schema is read, Then `change_kind` carries an `enum` of the lowercase spellings from the const `ChangeKind::parse` reads, every enum value parses, and `toolconf-probe` and `DROP` sent to it are refused by the validator with constraint `enum`.

Given `host.ask.create`, When `options` gets two equal strings and then two strings equal after trimming, Then the first is refused by the validator with constraint `uniqueItems`, and the second is refused by the validator through an `items` `pattern` forbidding leading/trailing whitespace or listed in `SCHEMA_VALID_REFUSALS` with reason `normalised`.

Given the PR head, When `mcphost contract dump --check` and the `docs/tools.md` drift check run, Then `contracts/host-tools.v1.json` carries every new keyword, both pass with no diff, and `planlim_ac07_contract_drift_with_deprecation_entry` passes, with one deprecation entry per narrowed descriptor if it requires one.

Given prod after deploy, When the public contract is fetched, Then `host.policy.set` `rule` is typed `array` and `host.sync.create` `table` carries a `pattern` (Live; evidence: `curl -s https://mcphost.dev/contract.json | jq -e '[.tools[]|select(.name=="host.policy.set")][0].input_schema.properties.rule.type=="array" and ([.tools[]|select(.name=="host.sync.create")][0].input_schema.properties.table.pattern|type=="string")'`)
acceptance_criteria.test: deferred: Live (prod; evidence: curl -s https://mcphost.dev/contract.json | jq -e on host.policy.set rule type and host.sync.create table pattern)

scope: src/sync/mod.rs: the SourceKind registry, host.sync.create/list/get/delete/run_now, and the trigger tick's sync pass writing a not_implemented sync_runs receipt.
migrations/0130_syncs.sql: syncs and sync_runs tables; Plan.syncs_max (free 5, pro 50) and the quota_syncs_max, connection_missing and schedule_too_frequent error codes.
www/llms.txt gains a generated Data sync section and docs/tools.md the source.kind enum, both rendered from SourceKind.
non_goals: Fetching rows (the pull PRD); push or conflict handling (the two-way PRD); type inference beyond text columns; any new OAuth flow.

additional.main_database_tables: syncs and sync_runs live in the main database (migration 0130), not a per-tenant file, so the tick's sync pass is one indexed query across tenants.

five_whys_trace.q: Why can an agent not keep a host table equal to a sheet?
five_whys_trace.a: No verb registers an external source; the agent would own a puller, a token and a diff loop.
host.table.append cannot update a row and host.trigger.set only calls a published tool.
One SourceKind enum generates the schema, docs and dispatch, so the five kinds cannot drift.

ambiguities_resolved.question: What is source.secret?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: The NAME of a host.secret (stored as secret_name), never a value, so no secret-named field exists on a Debug struct.

ambiguities_resolved.question: Do push and two_way modes run?
ambiguities_resolved.resolution: They are accepted at create with status pending_mode (the PRD default) and the tick skips them.
